text:
[RLOW.7.3.8] A call compiles to no supersedure sweep of its own. The
retraction [LCRS.6.2.1] requires is the engine's: it performs it while
evaluating the call's `FN_CALL` ([RDSC.4a.9.4]), on that call's correlation and
before it issues the request, taking the response schema from the service's
`ServiceDef` (`proto/service_def.proto#ServiceDef`, [LCRS.4.3.2]).

So the call's `cooldown` gate ([RLOW.4.6.6.1]) covers the sweep as it covers
the call: a gate that denies the call leaves its `FN_CALL` unevaluated, and the
call retracts nothing. A correlation the compiler generates for a call with no
`as` ([LCRS.3.1]) is swept as an `as` value is; it is unique within the engine
([LCCO.3.4]), so no earlier call's answer carries it.

idris.name: Rlow_7_3_8__acc
idris.note: The accumulator of the RHS with calls: the net and stamps, the call trackers, the records so far.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__admitted_call_supersedes
idris.note: The call's own sweep retracting the prior answer, computed. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__cooldown_suppressed_retracts_nothing
idris.note: The gate denying the call and the sweep with it, computed. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__empty_corr_call_sweeps_nothing
idris.note: A call whose `as` evaluates to "" supersedes nothing: its issue is the identity on the net. The generated correlation a call takes for an `as` that evaluates to "" is not modelled: the model has the empty text sweeping nothing, and the record carries it. LESS than the clause.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__issue
idris.note: The issue: the sweep on the site's correlation over the kinds its service answers with, before the request. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__issue_if
idris.note: The sweep inside the evaluation of the call, before the request, under the gate. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__issued_call_sweeps
idris.note: After an admitted firing's sweep no live answer of the service carries the firing's correlation. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__run_if_called
idris.note: The sweep inside the evaluation of the call, before the request, under the gate. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__suppressed_retracts_nothing
idris.note: The clause's second paragraph: the gate covers the sweep as it covers the call. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__swept_by_call
idris.note: The kinds a call sweeps, from the site's response kind. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__do_action_acc_inv
idris.note: One emit or withdraw on the accumulator keeps the invariant when it mints no answer.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__do_actions_called_inv
idris.note: The RHS with calls keeps the invariant when its actions mint no answer. By induction on the actions.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__run_sites_inv
idris.note: The sites of a position keep the invariant, one after the other.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__call_site
idris.note: The sweep inside the evaluation of the call, before the request, under the gate. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__site_decided
idris.note: The sweep inside the evaluation of the call, before the request, under the gate. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: lcrs_8_2__site_refused
idris.note: A gate that denies the call leaves the sweep unrun, as the clause places it inside the call's evaluation. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__at_position
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__do_action_acc
idris.note: One emit or withdraw on the accumulator: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's stamped action; the trackers and the records stand.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__do_actions_called
idris.note: The RHS with calls: at each position the sites there, then the action there; the sites past the last action after it.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__no_site_is_the_stamped_rhs
idris.note: With no call the RHS is the stamped RHS. LESS than the clause: that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema off the ServiceDef is the lowering's; the model takes the site's response kind.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__run_sites
idris.note: The sites of one position run in order, each on the accumulator the last left: two calls in one rule cool independently, a suppressed one stops nothing else.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__sites_at
idris.note: The sites at a position, in site order.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__with_stamped
idris.note: A definition the theorems and the witnesses read.

tla.name: lcrs_6_2_1__issued_call_sweeps
tla.note: The sweep on the call's correlation before the request: after an admitted firing no live answer carries the firing's correlation. A generated correlation is swept as an `as` value is and, unique within the engine, the sweep finds nothing under it -- the clause's last sentence; the nosweep teeth engine, which issues without sweeping, violates it. The lowering itself is not modelled.

tla.name: lcrs_6_2_1__suppressed_retracts_nothing
tla.note: The gate covers the sweep as it covers the call: a cooled call's firing inside its window leaves every live answer of its correlation live. The model has the sweep and the request as one step behind the gate, which is this clause's placement of the sweep inside the evaluation of the call; the ungated teeth engine, with the sweep ahead of the gate, violates it. The lowering itself -- that the call compiles to no sweep and the engine reads the response schema from the service's ServiceDef -- is not modelled.
